### The Precious Furnace of Affliction
Author: Vaneetha Rendall Risner
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-precious-furnace-of-affliction
Passage: Isaiah 48:10
Points:
- God uses the furnace of suffering to refine faith and sanctify believers in uniquely powerful ways.
- When life feels suffocating, crying out to God in honest prayer brings immediate spiritual relief.
- Lingering over God's promises in Scripture sustains the soul through overwhelming seasons of grief and distress.
- Intense trials teach believers to cultivate constant, unbroken dependence on the Lord throughout each day.
- Hardship yields precious spiritual treasures, including an intimacy with Christ that cannot be found anywhere else.
